declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (expectedRevision : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Revision)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Digest),
  expectedRevision ≠ state.revision →
    ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.publishCAS state expectedRevision nextGeneration nextDigest = none
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.stale_revision_publish_is_rejected

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (expectedRevision : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Revision)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Digest),
  state.writerOnline = false →
    ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.publishCAS state expectedRevision nextGeneration nextDigest = none
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.offline_writer_cannot_publish

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Digest),
  ¬state.activeGeneration < nextGeneration →
    ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.publishCAS state state.revision nextGeneration nextDigest = none
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.non_monotone_publish_is_rejected

declarations.type:
∀ (state next : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (expectedRevision : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Revision)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Digest),
  ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.publishCAS state expectedRevision nextGeneration nextDigest = some next →
    state.activeGeneration < next.activeGeneration
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.successful_publish_is_monotone

declarations.type:
∀ (state next : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (expectedRevision : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Revision)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.Digest),
  ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.publishCAS state expectedRevision nextGeneration nextDigest = some next →
    next.stagedGeneration = none
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.successful_publish_clears_staging

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (providerReady : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ProviderId → Bool)
  (provider : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ProviderId),
  state.readerOnline = true →
    providerReady provider = true → ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.SearchLoopAvailable state providerReady
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.one_ready_provider_preserves_searchloop

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.ServerState),
  state.readerOnline = true →
    ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.CanQuery (ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.stopWriter state)
      { workspace := state.workspace, generation := state.activeGeneration, revision := state.revision }
declarations.name: ASPProof.RuntimeServerSearchGeneration.writer_failure_preserves_active_query
